messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a new p99 tail on host parse after yesterday's kernel selector change. digging in.


dhruv: Can you paste the perf snapshot? which path: ingress preparse or slim-framer?

maria: preparse/tokenizer path. ran perf repro: ```ssh host-proxy-12 'sudo perf record -F 99 -p $(pidof host-proxy) -g -- sleep 30'``` CPU attr: ~45% tokenize, 20% grpc_writev, 15% kvcache lookup, rest syscalls.

patrick: did the kernel selector switch to prefer small-vec kernels for short seqs? that can increase memcpy/copy ops.

maria: yes — last rollout swapped short-seq profile to `smallvec_v2`. suspect extra serialization + writev churn.

anna: i profiled batching heuristics locally; when effective batch_size < 4 we get lots of micro-writes (writev) and http2 head-of-line. p95 increases ~12ms vs baseline.

kevin: note on KV cache: new eviction (LRU_bucket) shards lookups more aggressively under contention -> additional hop/counts; could explain kvcache portion increase.

dhruv: @maria can you upload the flamegraph link?

maria: uploaded: https://internal.gfx/fg/1764999999 (flame shows stack: tokenize -> memcpy -> writev -> grpc_finish dominating)

patrick: :eyes: hypothesis: smallvec_v2 triggers extra buffer copies before gRPC frames. rollback short-seq kernel selector on canary and compare.

kevin: i can run A/B on canary pool: smallvec_v1 vs smallvec_v2, end-to-end perfbench runs in ~8m.

ci-bot: canary started on pool-2 (canary-id 2026-AB12). perfbench jobs scheduled.

anna: also repro'd streaming chunker behavior — current chunk-window=256 causes many 256B frames for micro responses. bumping to 1024 locally dropped writev ops ~60% and helped p95.

dhruv: action items:
1) rollback kernel selector for short seqs on canary (maria)
2) run kvcache hot-shard trace with sampling=1% (kevin)
3) try chunk-window=1024 in host-proxy canary (anna)
4) collect p95/p99 + CPU breakdown and flamegraphs (everyone)

maria: starting rollback + perf collect now, will post numbers in ~15m :thumbsup:

patrick: if rollback fixes it, do gradual rollout with tracing flags on. else dig into batching uplift heuristics.

maria: quick numbers from local test: baseline p95=42ms; with chunk-window=1024 p95->29ms, p99 120ms->68ms. will confirm on canary.

kevin: great — i'll follow up with kvcache team about LRU_bucket hop counts and possible fastpath.

maria: closing loop: will update ticket ENGRT-894 with canary artifacts and write short postmortem once we have final data.

dhruv: thx all
